title: Constraint-Aware Test-Time Scoring for LLM and VLM Candidate Selection
abstract: arXiv:2611.33161v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When an LLM or VLM produces several candidate answers, picking the best one usually relies on the model's own confidence, a learned judge model, or a domain check. Each has a known weakness: an answer can be fluent but insecure, mathematically plausible but physically infeasible, or rated highly by a judge while quietly breaking a task requirement. We propose a scoring framework that combines a small set of hard checks every answer must pass with a wider set of softer checks whose scores are blended into one number per candidate. This adaptive scoring framework consists of three components: a drafting model that produces the candidates, a configuring model that selects and weights the checks for each task, and scoring models that rate properties no grounded tool can compute. translated_title: 面向大语言模型与视觉语言模型候选选择的约束感知测试时评分方法
translated_abstract: 当大语言模型（LLM）或视觉语言模型（VLM）产生多个候选答案时，挑选最佳答案通常依赖于模型自身的置信度、经过训练的评判模型或领域检查。每种方法都有已知的弱点：答案可能流畅但不安全，数学上看似合理但物理上不可行，或者被评判模型打出高分却悄悄违反了任务要求。我们提出了一个评分框架，将每个答案必须通过的一小组硬性检查与更广泛的一组软性检查相结合，软性检查的分数被融合为每个候选答案的一个数值。这个自适应评分框架由三个组件构成：生成候选答案的起草模型、为每个任务选择并加权检查项的配置模型，以及对无法通过接地工具计算的属性进行评分的评分模型。我们将所提方法应用于四个任务：编写既正确又安全的代码（CWEval）、生成机器人操作计划（LIBERO及附加的安全变化……）
tldr: 本文提出一个约束感知的测试时评分框架，将候选答案必须通过的硬性检查与可加权的软性检查相融合，从LLM和VLM生成的多个候选中选出最佳答案，并应用于代码安全生成、机器人操作规划等四个任务。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a constraint-aware test-time scoring framework that blends mandatory hard checks with weighted soft checks to select the best among multiple LLM/VLM candidate answers, validated on four tasks including secure code generation and robot manipulation planning.
